label: Statutory salary as Prime Minister (ministervederlag), annual rate from 1 April 2026
detail: Ministers' pay is set by the act on remuneration and pension for ministers. Regeringen.dk publishes the rates: the Prime Minister receives 125% of the base amount, DKK 1,958,176.25 at the 31 March 2026 level, or DKK 2,030,628.77 a year after the 3.7% adjustment of 1 April 2026, under the scheme that applies to ministers who were already ministers or MPs before the 2026 election. This is the published rate for the office, not a personal declaration. The government also publishes each minister's own declaration of personal financial interests (oplysningsskema) as a PDF on the minister's page; the harvest used for this research does not render PDFs, so its contents are not reproduced here.
